description: Defines a ControlSizeTrigger class for UI state management based on control size, including dependency properties for Source, MinHeight, and MinWidth, and logic to activate/deactivate based on size changes.

classes.name: ControlSizeTrigger
classes.description: A sealed class inheriting from StateTriggerBase that activates based on the size of a specified control.

methods.name: ControlSizeTrigger
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the trigger and sets it to inactive.

methods.name: Source
methods.description: Property to get or set the source FrameworkElement for size monitoring.

methods.name: OnSourcePropertyChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to the Source property, updating event subscriptions.

methods.name: RegisterSizeChanged
methods.description: Subscribes to SizeChanged event of the specified FrameworkElement.

methods.name: UnregisterSizeChanged
methods.description: Unsubscribes from SizeChanged event of the specified FrameworkElement.

methods.name: OnSizeChanged
methods.description: Event handler that updates the trigger's active state based on new size.

methods.name: UpdateIsActive
methods.description: Activates or deactivates the trigger based on size thresholds MinHeight and MinWidth.
